english.title: Aid / abet escape from lawful custody
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) aided, abetted, counselled or procured **(..SPECIFY NAME..),

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

being in

(C)_[lawful custody,]_
(D)_[lawful custody on a criminal charge,]_

to escape from the said custody
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8 of the Accessories and Abettors Act 1861.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
aided/abetted/counselled/procured a person in lawful custody
on criminal charge to escape from that lawful custody

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording may be used where the accused has been arrested but not yet charged by police, is awaiting trial or sentence, or is serving a sentence.
(ii) See the substantive offence at H614.

(A)_[ac yntau'n cael ei ddal]_
(B)_[a hithau'n cael ei dal]_

yn

(C)_[gaeth yn gyfreithlon,]_
(D)_[gaeth yn gyfreithlon ar gyhuddiad troseddol,]_

i ddianc o'r gaethiwed honno
